instructions.title: Game Instructions
instructions.intro: Transcendance is an online gaming platform where you can challenge a bot or other players in real-time in the classic Rock-Paper-Scissors game. Our version includes an Elo ranking system to track your progress.
instructions.rulesDesc: The principle is simple: each player simultaneously chooses one of three elements. Here's how winners are determined:
instructions.rockBeats: Rock (🪨) crushes Scissors (✂️) - You win if your opponent chooses Scissors
instructions.scissorsBeat: Scissors (✂️) cut Paper (📄) - You win if your opponent chooses Paper
instructions.paperBeats: Paper (📄) covers Rock (🪨) - You win if your opponent chooses Rock
instructions.equal: Same choices = Draw, no points awarded
instructions.vsBotStep1: Access the main menu from your personal space
instructions.vsBotStep2: Click on the 'Play against a bot' button (🤖)
instructions.vsBotStep3: A pop-up window appears to confirm your username - click 'Start!'
instructions.vsBotStep4: Choose from the three options: Rock (🪨), Paper (📄), or Scissors (✂️)
instructions.vsBotStep5: The bot responds automatically and the result is displayed. First to 3 points wins the match
instructions.vsPlayerDesc: Face other players in real-time with our matchmaking system:
instructions.vsPlayerStep1: Access the main menu from your personal space
instructions.vsPlayerStep2: Click on the 'Play against a player' button (👥)
instructions.vsPlayerStep3: Click 'Start!' - the system searches for an available opponent
instructions.vsPlayerStep4: Once an opponent is found, you have 5 seconds to make your choice
instructions.vsPlayerStep5: First to 3 winning rounds wins the match. Results affect your Elo ranking
instructions.winsLossesDesc: Each win and loss is recorded on your profile. Your win rate is calculated automatically: (wins / games played) × 100.
instructions.eloDesc: The Elo rating is a system used to calculate the relative skill level of players. Here's how it works on Transcendance:
instructions.eloWin: You gain Elo points when you defeat an opponent
instructions.eloLose: You lose Elo points when you are defeated
instructions.eloAgainst: The larger the ranking gap with your opponent, the more points you gain or lose
instructions.tip1: There is no foolproof strategy for Rock-Paper-Scissors, it's a pure game of chance. Each move has an equal probability of winning.
instructions.tip2: Make your choice quickly! You only have 5 seconds per round in PvP mode before the system counts it as a timeout.
instructions.tip3: Regularly check your profile to track your progress and Elo ranking.
instructions.tip4: Play against the bot to practice before facing real players.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.simpleDesc: We need a few bits of info to make the game work, that's it. No selling, no sharing with strangers, no dark patterns.
privacy.collectDesc: Just what we need to play and recognize you:
privacy.useDesc: To make the game work, plain and simple. Your account, your games, your ranking... without this, we can't do much. We also use your IP address for security reasons (to prevent cheaters, spammers, etc.).
privacy.sharingDesc: No one, except you and us. We don't sell your data, we don't give it away, we don't share it.
privacy.sharingException: Unless the law requires us to (and that's rare).
privacy.cookiesDesc: We only use one to keep you logged in during your session. That's all. No tracking, no targeted ads, no reselling.
privacy.rightsDesc: You have the right to know what we have on you, to modify it, to delete it, or to get a copy. It's the law (GDPR).
privacy.rightsContact: If you want to exercise any of these rights, contact us, we'll take care of it.
